### Starbucks Development

- Officially opened Saturday, October 18 2024
- "Special thanks to partners Rusty and Jake Ertle and Edwards Construction for their exceptional building services. 🌟"
- [LinkedIn Post](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7254161414351699968/?updateEntityUrn=urn%3Ali%3Afs_updateV2%3A%28urn%3Ali%3Aactivity%3A7254161414351699968%2CFEED_DETAIL%2CEMPTY%2CDEFAULT%2Cfalse%29)
- [Article](https://www.madraspioneer.com/business/starbucks-plans-move-forward-for-south-y-in-madras/article_73540f46-72ad-11ee-a6c7-5b1f9ed6739a.html)
- 
	- `The stand-alone building at the South Y has been in development for about four years, since the developer purchased the land from the county in 2021. Planning and access issues with the Oregon Department of Transportation delayed the project, which began construction in May.`
`The $2 million project features a 2,460-square-foot building with a drive-thru. The developer estimates 150,000 customers per year at this location.`

[Article 2](https://www.biztrib.com/news/jefferson-county-sweetens-contract-for-starbucks-developer/article_f6a54479-0375-57e1-81b1-e61645359724.html)
- "Jefferson County Commissioners will give developer Jake Ertle more time, up to 30 months, to begin construction of a Starbucks at the South Y in Madras, and removed the contract stipulation that he develop the rest of the property."
- "Ertle is further concerned construction ODOT has planned for 2025-26 on Fourth and Fifth streets through Madras will block customers from his coffee shop."


[Article 3](https://www.bendbulletin.com/localstate/starbucks-proposed-at-madras-gateway-property/article_29016a2c-8d92-11eb-8132-d782a5d27d50.html)
- "Ertle Development Partners, an Arizona-based development company, submitted a proposal to build a 2,000-square-foot Starbucks with a patio and drive-thru on the vacant “South Y” gateway, where vehicles traveling north on U.S. Highway 97 enter a split into a one-way street through downtown Madras. Jake Ertle, who runs the company with his father, Rusty, said the plan needs to be negotiated with Jefferson County, which bought the property from the Oregon Department of Transportation for $205,629 with the intent to sell the space for immediate development. The development company’s proposal is to buy the property for $210,000 and complete the coffee shop within 16 months. A second phase would include building a 3,375-square-foot retail building for a brewery or restaurant. Madras has a Starbucks inside Safeway on the north end of the city, but no free-standing location with a drive-thru. Starbucks estimates about 150,000 customers would visit the new location each year, according to the development proposal."
- Ertle has experience developing properties in Central Oregon. His company is building a Starbucks in the former Platypus Pub location on Third Street in Bend. And the company built the Redmond Town Center at the corner of U.S. Highway 97 and Veterans Way. The visibility of the Madras property as a southern gateway along Highway 97 drew Ertle to the property, he said. The 38,000-square-foot property, which includes a 2,000-square-foot building, is the first sight of the city from the south for more than 15,000 travelers each day, according to city data. The site at 813 SW Highway 97 has been vacant for about six years since ODOT used the property for a [highway realignment project](https://www.bendbulletin.com/localstate/work-on-u-s-highway-97-in-madras-begins/article_6b99d8fc-bf49-5d61-a8c7-5426def3392f.html). Before ODOT owned the property, it was an administration office for the Crooked River National Grassland.
